sources.label: Official Reiss size guide (Men's clothing chart, cm)

audit: Stored URL /p/size-guide 404s; guide is at /size-guide. Men's clothing chart (XS-XXXL, chest and waist) stored in cm as Reiss prints them (inch originals in _in; Reiss's cm are its own figures, e.g. 34.5 in shown as 86 cm). Old values were 1-2 cm off: XS chest 88 -> 86, waist 71 -> 72; M chest 98 -> 97, waist 81 -> 82; XL 108/91 -> 107/92. XXXL added. Reiss's men's international table (XS = UK/US 28, EU 44) is not stored as UK/EU sizes because its UK column looks like waist sizes and XXXL is listed as EU 55.
